built_recovery_candidate.description: Planned fixture: an isolated candidate with ORI-AST-001, ORI-AST-004 and ORI-CONT-005, built through production entrypoints and served at http://localhost:4321.
records: Run pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs build with the prerequisite's production Pagefind step; retain actual build output and the emitted asset hashes.
Use the actual apps/docs/src/content/system/not-found.md manuscript; record its title, explanation and distinctive search-hint phrase without inventing copy.
The real index contains Message at /components/message; /components and /registry provide substantive recovery destinations.
Record a fresh run ID, candidate source, lockfile, test-source, dist, Pagefind, surface-policy and coldboot-policy hashes, plus the owned preview PID; refuse an unowned listener.
Open fresh desktop/mobile browser contexts and a separate JavaScript-disabled context. Generate an unknown /docs/ path from the current run ID; create no route or page for it.

requirements.name: Recover to Message through shared search
requirements.description: GIVEN the built candidate and a fresh unknown /docs/ URL WHEN the visitor activates Search the site and selects Message THEN the focused dialog opens within 300ms and reaches substantive Message content at /components/message with HTTP 200.
requirements.verification_service: Real built Astro preview at http://localhost:4321, emitted custom 404.html, production Pagefind index, real HTTP navigation, and actual Playwright browser keyboard and focus

scenario.verification_service: Real built Astro preview at http://localhost:4321, emitted custom 404.html, production Pagefind index, real HTTP navigation, and actual Playwright browser keyboard and focus

would_fail_if: The recovery page is an empty static shell, its search trigger is disconnected, or its Message navigation is a no-op.

steps: In the real desktop and mobile projects, navigate to a fresh run-specific unknown /docs/ URL and capture the actual response and manuscript content.
Activate Search the site; measure activation-to-dialog visibility independently of Pagefind readiness and inspect the actual focused input.
Await the real index, type message, highlight the actual Message result with keyboard input and press Enter.

must_observe: Recovery title, explanation and search hint equal the actual `system/not-found.md` manuscript.
The native dialog has `aria-modal=true`, becomes visible within 300ms, and focuses its search input.
Selecting `Message` closes the dialog and navigates to `/components/message` with HTTP 200 and the rendered Message heading and substantive reference content.
must_not_observe: An empty recovery shell, a disconnected search trigger, or the unchanged unknown URL after selecting Message.

requirements.name: Emit the manuscript-backed recovery document and retain the shell
requirements.description: GIVEN the real system manuscript and a theme selected through the site control WHEN the visitor opens a fresh unknown URL THEN the emitted 404.html supplies the manuscript, retained theme, header and footer without creating an ordinary docs entry.
requirements.verification_service: Real built Astro preview at http://localhost:4321, emitted custom 404.html, production Pagefind index, real HTTP navigation, and actual Playwright browser keyboard and focus

scenario.verification_service: Real built Astro preview at http://localhost:4321, emitted custom 404.html, production Pagefind index, real HTTP navigation, and actual Playwright browser keyboard and focus

would_fail_if: The custom 404 document is absent, a static generic shell replaces the manuscript, or the page omits DocsLayout.

steps: Read the emitted apps/docs/dist/404.html identity and the actual system manuscript; compare them with recovery content served at a fresh unknown URL.
Inspect the real docs collection configuration and ordinary docs navigation for an unintended not-found entry.
Select light and then dark through the existing theme control, revisiting a fresh unknown URL after each selection; observe the shared header and footer.

must_observe: `apps/docs/dist/404.html` is emitted and its served title, explanation and hint match `apps/docs/src/content/system/not-found.md`.
`system/not-found.md` remains outside the docs collection and ordinary documentation navigation.
Both selected `light` and `dark` themes remain on the recovery page with the shared header, footer, `Components` link and `Registry` link.
must_not_observe: A blank/default missing-page document, an ordinary not-found docs entry, or a theme reset after navigation.

requirements.name: Restore focus and exclude recovery content from the shared index
requirements.description: GIVEN recovery and ordinary pages use the production index WHEN the visitor dismisses recovery search and compares actual searches THEN Escape restores trigger focus, Message resolves identically, and recovery URLs are excluded from results.
requirements.verification_service: Real built Astro preview at http://localhost:4321, emitted custom 404.html, production Pagefind index, real HTTP navigation, and actual Playwright browser keyboard and focus

scenario.verification_service: Real built Astro preview at http://localhost:4321, emitted custom 404.html, production Pagefind index, real HTTP navigation, and actual Playwright browser keyboard and focus

would_fail_if: Focus restoration is a no-op, search resources are disconnected from the production index, or a hardcoded result list conceals an indexed 404 document.

steps: Revisit a fresh unknown URL, open recovery search and press Escape; observe the focused element.
Open search on an ordinary page and on the recovery page, query message in each, and compare actual module/index request URLs and the Message result destination.

must_observe: `Escape` closes the dialog and focus returns to the actual `Search the site` invoking control.
Both searches load the same production `Pagefind` resources and return `Message` at `/components/message`.
must_not_observe: No focused recovery trigger after dismissal, an empty Message result set, or a disconnected alternate index.

steps: On ordinary-page search, query the exact missing-page title and then a distinctive phrase read from the current system manuscript.
Wait for each real search to complete, record its count and returned URLs, and inspect every returned destination.

must_observe: Completed searches for the two manuscript-derived queries exclude `/404`, `/404.html` and every current-run unknown `/docs/` URL.
Each query records its actual `Pagefind` result count and URL list; a zero-result response is permitted only after real index completion.
must_not_observe: A placeholder result list, an indexed 404 recovery URL, or a loading state counted as an empty search response.

requirements.name: Recover through ordinary links without JavaScript
requirements.description: GIVEN JavaScript is disabled WHEN the visitor reads an unknown page and follows Components and Registry THEN the explanation remains readable and both links reach matching content with HTTP 200.
requirements.verification_service: Real built Astro preview at http://localhost:4321, emitted custom 404.html, production Pagefind index, real HTTP navigation, and actual Playwright browser keyboard and focus

scenario.verification_service: Real built Astro preview at http://localhost:4321, emitted custom 404.html, production Pagefind index, real HTTP navigation, and actual Playwright browser keyboard and focus

would_fail_if: The no-JavaScript document is empty, recovery links are script-only no-ops, or either destination is a static success placeholder.

steps: In a JavaScript-disabled context, navigate to a fresh unknown /docs/ URL, read the actual explanation and follow the plain Components link.

must_observe: The manuscript explanation and shared header/footer remain readable with `javaScriptEnabled=false`.
The plain `Components` link reaches `/components` with HTTP 200 and rendered component-family content.
must_not_observe: An empty recovery page, a disabled/plain-link no-op, or the unchanged unknown URL.

steps: In the same JavaScript-disabled context, revisit a fresh unknown /docs/ URL and follow the plain Registry link.

must_observe: The plain `Registry` link reaches `/registry` with HTTP 200 and rendered registry ledger content.
must_not_observe: An empty registry shell, a script-only link, or the unchanged unknown URL.

requirements.description: Search the site opens the focused aria-modal dialog within 300ms; selecting the real Message result closes it and reaches /components/message with HTTP 200 and substantive content.
The emitted 404.html matches the system manuscript, retains both selected themes and shared shell, and adds no ordinary docs collection or navigation entry.
Escape restores recovery-trigger focus; ordinary and recovery searches share real Pagefind resources and Message destination; completed manuscript queries exclude recovery URLs.
With JavaScript disabled, the recovery explanation and shell remain readable and Components and Registry links reach matching content with HTTP 200.
